turns.stem: Moist air crosses a ridge and descends toward station B. Which change best explains B’s rain shadow?
choices: Warming during descent lowers relative humidity
Cooling during descent forces continuing condensation
Warming during ascent increases precipitation at B
Lower pressure on descent removes ground moisture
turns.response: Warming during ascent increases precipitation at B

turns.stem: A fertiliser factory reports a production cut during gas shortages even with ample labour. Which input relationship explains this?
choices: Gas replaces all the water used by crops
Gas is needed only for transporting finished bags
Natural gas is a feedstock for ammonia production
Natural gas supplies phosphate rock directly
turns.response: Natural gas is a feedstock for ammonia production

turns.stem: A surveyor travels downstream from Guddu, stopping at the next labelled barrage before Kotri. Which pin records that stop?
choices: D
E
F
C

turns.stem: Order these events from earliest to latest. X = Transfer to the Crown, Y = Battle of Buxar, Z = Regulating Act.
choices: Y → X → Z
X → Y → Z
Y → Z → X
Z → Y → X

turns.stem: Why does winning more seats than any rival fail to establish that a party can govern alone?
choices: The largest party is constitutionally barred from coalitions
A plurality may fall short of an absolute majority
Every seat is reserved for independents
The president must represent the smallest party
turns.response: A plurality may fall short of an absolute majority

turns.stem: Which observation best supports the claim that a northern mountain route can facilitate international trade?
choices: Commercial freight crosses the border via the Karakoram Highway
Visitor numbers rise in a domestic resort
A valley opens a new guesthouse
Snowmelt feeds a local irrigation channel
turns.response: Commercial freight crosses the border via the Karakoram Highway

turns.stem: Which combination would let a historian distinguish authorship from later political influence?
choices: Attribute every later League decision to the address’s author
Identify who delivered the Allahabad Address, then trace how later actors used its ideas
Treat a pamphlet title as proof of government policy
Count every later use of the name Pakistan as a vote in 1930
turns.response: Attribute every later League decision to the address’s author

turns.stem: Which organisation linked Pakistan specifically with Iran and Turkey in economic cooperation during the 1960s?
choices: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation
Regional Cooperation for Development
United Nations Security Council
Commonwealth

turns.stem: A country earns most export revenue from one textile market. Which strategy most directly reduces exposure to a downturn in that market?
choices: Sell a wider range of goods to several destinations
Concentrate all orders in one overseas distributor
Ship the same goods to the same buyers in larger containers
Invoice the same buyer twice a month
turns.response: Sell a wider range of goods to several destinations

turns.stem: Why could a natural disaster in the eastern wing turn into a constitutional grievance in 1970?
choices: A cyclone automatically changed the seat allocation
The perceived inadequacy of federal relief deepened distrust of central rule
Relief policy gave the western wing a new coastline
The storm legally cancelled the Six Points
turns.response: The perceived inadequacy of federal relief deepened distrust of central rule
